name: sketchforge
description: Browser-first Arduino editor with in-browser compilation and Web Serial flashing

scripts.build: npm run build:ck-browser-core && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify:ck-browser-action-graph-matrix: npm run verify:ck-browser-esp32-action-graph && npm run verify:ck-browser-s2-action-graph && npm run verify:ck-browser-s3-action-graph && npm run verify:ck-browser-c3-action-graph && npm run verify:ck-browser-c6-action-graph
scripts.verify:project-docs: npm run test:project-docs && npm run audit:project-docs
scripts.test:ck-library-matrix-contracts: npm run test:ck-browser-library-matrix && vitest run packages/core/test/native-library-matrix.test.ts packages/core/test/native-library-pack-verifier.test.ts packages/web/test/verify-ck-browser-large-library-matrix.test.ts && npm run verify:ck-browser-library-matrix -- --plan && npm run verify:ck-native-library-matrix -- --plan
scripts.verify:ck-native-action-graph-matrix: npm run verify:native-action-graph && npm run verify:native-esp32-action-graph:esp32 && npm run verify:native-esp32-action-graph:s2 && npm run verify:native-esp32-action-graph:s3 && npm run verify:native-esp32-action-graph:c3 && npm run verify:native-esp32-action-graph:c6
scripts.prewarm:avr: npm run build --workspace @sketchforge/server && npm run prewarm:avr --workspace @sketchforge/server
scripts.prewarm:esp32: npm run build --workspace @sketchforge/server && npm run prewarm:esp32 --workspace @sketchforge/server
scripts.prebuild:firmware-assets: npm run build --workspace @sketchforge/server && npm run prebuild:firmware-assets --workspace @sketchforge/server
scripts.prebuild:featured-firmware: npm run build --workspace @sketchforge/server && npm run prebuild:featured-firmware --workspace @sketchforge/server
scripts.test: npm run test:source && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:unit: vitest run packages/core/test/build-ir.test.ts packages/core/test/request-fingerprint.test.ts packages/web/test/project-files.test.ts packages/web/test/project-state.test.ts packages/web/test/editor-workflow.test.ts packages/web/test/browser-action-cache.test.ts packages/web/test/app-p1-wiring.test.ts
